reason: Staging has final signed artifact paths and transaction publications. The release blocker is the contradictory final completion, recipient delivery, access, and UI state after generation.

completed.requiredTruth: ready=true and stage=completed_everywhere must require final artifact, transaction publication, surface completion, and complete recipient delivery or a formal controlled-test delivery outcome.

delivered.requiredTruth: each signer must have append-only final delivery evidence recorded through bridge_record_final_delivery_f3; controlled test recipients must not call the real provider.

controlledTestRecipient.requiredTruth: test recipient domains and explicit test metadata must produce staging-safe suppression evidence.

downloadable.requiredTruth: authorized workspace, portal, and signer contexts must resolve a published final artifact to a short-lived signed PDF URL.

accessFence.requiredTruth: artifact evidence, publication, storage integrity, and visibility must match before any download URL is minted.

retryable.requiredTruth: retry must reuse immutable final artifacts and re-run delivery/publication without duplicating unsafe state.

workspaceUi.requiredTruth: the workspace must not show Completed everywhere while recipient delivery is pending.

smokeHarness.requiredTruth: browser smoke must verify actual final signed download links without sending real email.
